summary: Iter 150: Verified gender confirmation step, men/women sections, gender persistence, preview validation and admin catalog regression. All 9 backend tests pass and full FE mobile flow (skip camera → gender → results sections → pick → done code) works end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: hair_colors.py is >600 lines and mixes catalog, picker, poster, preview, share card, stylist result and reels — consider splitting into color_catalog.py, color_public.py, color_result.py.
public_color_pick does not validate that 'gender' matches men-flag of the chosen shade (a guest can pick men=false shade after selecting men). Not a bug per spec, but could reject or coerce.
_service_links runs 2 sequential Mongo queries per catalog fetch — fine at 18 shades but N+1-ish for future scaling.
seed_data_creation: Created a handful of TEST_QA_* color_picks documents in color_picks collection during pick tests; harmless.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 150 gender step + men/women sections + gender persistence fully verified. Backend test file test_iter150_gender_step.py can be reused. FE preview (Gemini) was intentionally not exercised end-to-end per instructions.
